views.question: Will NVIDIA commence production shipments of its Vera Rubin platform by December 31, 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences production shipments of Vera Rubin on or before 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA does not commence production shipments of Vera Rubin on or before 2026-12-31.
